resources.string: This phone has no speech recognition service
The system will not ask again — turn it on in the app settings.
Printed text is recognized on the phone. The photo is not saved or sent anywhere. Handwriting cannot be read.
Hold the sheet flat, close to the camera, in good light.
The camera is used only to photograph the prescription. The photo is not saved or sent anywhere.
This takes a few seconds. Everything happens on the phone.
Take the photo flat, closer and in good light. Handwriting cannot be read — type the lines or dictate them.
The photo could not be opened. Choose another one.
The photo is too large for the phone. Choose a smaller one.
Text recognition did not start. If it happens again, type the text instead.
The camera could not be opened. Choose a photo from the gallery.
For example: “Amoxicillin five hundred, one capsule three times a day for a week”
Speech is recognized on the phone if the offline language is downloaded; otherwise the phone\'s recognition service may use the internet.
The microphone is used only to dictate the prescription. The recording is not saved.
Speak closer to the microphone and try again.
There is no internet, and the language for recognition without it is not downloaded. Download it in the phone settings (voice input, offline recognition) and try again.
The microphone is busy or unavailable. Close other apps that record sound.
Speech recognition did not start. Try again.
